args.title: Fix the password reset email link to use the correct production URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently constructs the reset link with BASE_URL set to process.env.PUBLIC_URL or defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not defined. This causes reset link emails to localhost in production environments where PUBLIC_URL might not be set correctly. This change proposes ensuring the email template uses the correct production URL for reset links, avoiding localhost links in emailed URLs.
